text:
Samir: Heads-up — scheduling rollout of model "abyss-v2" in EU region tonight during the 23:00-01:00 UTC change window. Need rollback/pin plan + fallback ordering. :wave:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout requested by @Samir for 2107897200. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% in 30m steps. Preflight checks queued. :rocket:
Alice: Please ensure we pin the legacy variant "abyss-v2-legacy" in eu-west as an immediate fallback. We saw latency drift last month.
Ben: +1 on pin. Suggested fallback order: abyss-v2 (primary) -> abyss-v2-legacy (pinned) -> titan-quant (cost/fallback). Set fallback TTL 30m.
Carla: Recommend region-split: start in eu-west only, verify, then expand to eu-central. Avoid global shift on first go.
Tina: Observability hooks: dashboard `catalog/abyss-v2/eu/latency` updated, SLI alerts configured. I'll run a quick eval against P0 prompts during canary.
Samir: Rollback trigger thresholds: error rate > 2% OR median p99 latency > 800ms. Rollback command (manual): `redwood catalog pin --model abyss --variant abyss-v2-legacy --region eu-west --force`
Ben: Note: use `--dry-run` first on the pin command to validate the config and routing. Canary start command: `redwood traffic set --model abyss --variant abyss-v2 --pct 5 --region eu-west`
Carla: Ops runbook updated: https://wiki.internal/redwood/release/runbooks/abyss-eu — Incident lead: @Tina, backup: @Alice.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed: infra quotas OK, model artifacts verified, kernel compatibility v1.4. Ready to start canary at 23:00 UTC.
Tina: I'll watch traces + sampled responses. Add automatic regression check: hallucination delta > 0.05 from baseline -> trigger pager.
Samir: Decision: proceed with region-split rollout as planned. If any borderline signal, immediate pin to legacy and open incident channel #inc-abyss-eu.
Alice: :thumbsup: I'll be on-call and ready to execute rollback pin.
ops-bot: Change window lockfile created: /locks/releases/2107890123-abyss-eu.lock
deploy-bot: Canary started -> 5% traffic to abyss-v2 in eu-west. Will report metrics in 5m.
Ben: :eyes: watching p50/p95/p99 and error budget burn
Samir: If stable after 60m we'll proceed to 25% then full. I'll post post-deploy notes and a short RCA if rollback occurs.
